meta.namingConvention: All custom keys prefixed Na__. Three-stage form Na__Section__SubSection__FieldName.

fieldPrefixes.Na__Asset__: Top-level asset metadata and content blocks
fieldPrefixes.Na__Geometry__: Geometry sub-fields (BoundingBox, Counts, OriginNote, CoordSystem, Paths, EdgeStyleLegend)
fieldPrefixes.Na__View__: 2D projection provenance (source view, camera axes, projection type)
fieldPrefixes.Na__Object__: 3D hierarchy nodes (ids, names, tags, transforms, visibility)
fieldPrefixes.Na__Edge__: Authored edge style (soft, smooth, hidden, resolved display, tag, colour)
fieldPrefixes.Na__Face__: Authored face state (hidden, resolved display, tag, back material)

Na__Asset__Metadata.Na__Asset__Metadata__Description: The first blocking, seating atop the aluminium core extrusion. It is the substrate the primary ridge lead flashing is dressed over.
Na__Asset__Metadata.Na__Asset__Metadata__DataStatus: Published - 22.5 degree CAD standard, metadata audited 12-Aug-2026
Na__Asset__Metadata.Na__Asset__Metadata__StandardsNote: Taken from the 22.5 Degree CAD Standards library held by the Vale Garden Houses technical department, captured 12-Aug-2026. Every section and component in this set is authored for a 22.5 degree roof; other pitches are reached by transforming these assets rather than by holding a separate library per pitch.

Na__Asset__ValeSpecification.Na__Asset__ValeSpec__Notes: Bare timber finish - concealed under the leadwork. Its two seating faces are cut to the roof pitch and are re-sloped about the shoulder of the core for pitches other than the 22.5 degree standard.

Na__Geometry__EdgeStyleLegend.Na__Edge__IsSoft: SketchUp soft: edge is not drawn AND its adjacent faces merge into a Surface entity. Does not by itself change shading.
Na__Geometry__EdgeStyleLegend.Na__Edge__IsSmooth: SketchUp smooth: adjacent face shading blends across the edge (averaged vertex normals). On its own the edge REMAINS VISIBLE; SketchUp hides it only because Soften/Smooth sets soft and smooth together.
Na__Geometry__EdgeStyleLegend.Na__Edge__IsHidden: SketchUp Edit > Hide: edge is not drawn. Faces are NOT merged into a surface and shading is unchanged.
Na__Geometry__EdgeStyleLegend.Na__Edge__IsDisplayed: Resolved draw test: true when NOT soft AND NOT hidden AND the edge tag is visible. Smooth alone does not suppress the line. Consume this directly instead of re-deriving the rules or applying an angle-based softening filter.
Na__Geometry__EdgeStyleLegend.Na__Edge__ColorHex: Colour of the material painted on the edge itself. When Na__Edge__HasOwnMaterial is false this is the SketchUp default edge colour (#000000) and the edge should be left unpainted on re-import.
Na__Geometry__EdgeStyleLegend.ShadingNote: Vertex normals in Na__Geometry__Vertices are already averaged across smoothed edges via face.mesh(7) / normal_at, so smooth shading is baked into the exported normals and needs no downstream recomputation.

Na__Asset__ObjectHierarchy3D.Na__Hierarchy__OriginNote: Hierarchy captured from the component definition with nested groups/components preserved.
